extension.news: v3.3.5 - Resume on a title page starts where you stopped, and Play from beginning starts at the beginning (needs KDMM 2.7.13) v3.3.4 - First-run setup: after Trakt is connected with Connect Trakt, setup finishes and Home opens by itself; if the sign-in is cancelled or the code expires, setup stays on the Trakt step v3.3.3 - The remote works straight away at launch: focus no longer sits on a hidden control until Left or Right is pressed - Pressing Right on an episode no longer makes the selection disappear - After watching an episode picked from More Episodes, Back returns to the show's page and then Home, without the page stacked twice (needs KDMM 2.7.11) v3.3.2 - A show's "Play Season X: Episode Y" button shows the episode straight away instead of "Loading..." for several seconds; the Trakt answer still updates it (needs KDMM 2.7.9) - That button can be pressed before the Trakt answer arrives, and now works in both title page layouts v3.3.1 - More Episodes, and every other movie, show, season and episode list, opened to an empty screen after 3.3.0 renamed the views. Saved view choices from before the rename are recognised again - Music lists no longer open empty: they use the List view in place of the removed Square view v3.3.0 - The home, screensaver and startup logos and the settings background now show the Deflix name - Menus and settings say Deflix instead of Bingie - The dark panel behind the logo in the bottom-right corner is gone v3.2.1 - Title logos no longer get cut off at the top on TVs that crop the screen's edges - Watch Later: quick repeated presses no longer get stuck, and a press reloads only the Watch Later rows v3.2.0 - New startup intro: the provider logos circle the screen faster and faster, burst into their colours and reveal the Deflix name - The loading circle no longer shows over the intro - Sidebar: new HBO Max, Paramount+ and Crunchyroll hubs, each with its own theme and rows v3.1.1 - Title pages: the Watch Later button now sits below More Episodes v3.1.0 - KDMM, the add-on that plays movies and episodes, now installs with the skin and becomes TMDb Bingie Helper's default player - Netflix hub: its own dark red theme, like Prime Video and Disney+ - The sidebar takes the colour of the provider hub that is open - Row names say what the rows hold: Lucasfilm, Walt Disney Pictures, Marvel Studios, Original Series, Action Movies and more - First-run screens rewritten for the provider hubs, Trakt and KDMM, with a Connect Trakt button v3.0.0 - New sidebar: Search, Home, Prime Video, Netflix, Apple TV and Disney+, replacing the Movies, TV, New, Categories, My List and Surprise Me hubs - Each provider hub lists its catalogue from TMDb (Top 100 movies and shows, originals, new titles, genres) and has its own colour theme - New row styles: ranked rows with large numerals and large landscape cards - Home now shows your Trakt rows: continue watching, watch later, recently watched and recommendations - Watch Later button on title pages (your Trakt watchlist) - Title pages scroll as one page into the collection and "More like this" rows - Menus and rows customised in 2.x are reset to the new defaults once - The Deflix repository now also provides the Bingie add-ons the skin needs v2.3.0 - Remove the unused Inter font set and its 10 MB of font files; the Default (Netflix Sans) and Arial font sets remain v2.2.1 - Fix empty Home menu after a skin update: rebuild menus when the main menu has no items

extension.summary: Install and update the Deflix Kodi skin.
extension.description: Repository for the Deflix Kodi skin and the add-ons it depends on, including the KDMM player.

extension.summary: Kodi Debrid Media Manager playback bridge
extension.description: Receives movie and episode play requests from TMDb Bingie Helper, looks up torrents through Torrentio (or Debrid Media Manager with a sponsor API key), resolves cached Real-Debrid and/or AllDebrid streams, and passes direct playback URLs to Kodi. Includes quality sorting, AV1 and preferred-audio probing, stream cleanup, stream and TV pack caching, local resume progress, IntroDB-backed skip buttons, next-episode overlays, a return to the title's page when playback stops or ends, and remote keymaps for OSD on Up/Down and seek-on-release FF/RW.
